task_completion.description: The OpenBCI GUI application is launched and visible.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenBCI GUI window is open on the desktop.

task_completion.description: The agent selects 'Synthetic (Board)' as the data source.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Synthetic' radio button or dropdown option is selected in the system control panel.

task_completion.description: The agent starts the session to begin data streaming.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start Session' button is clicked and the GUI transitions to the data visualization dashboard.

task_completion.description: The agent initiates the recording of the synthetic data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Start Recording' button is clicked, and the recording timer or status indicator changes to 'Recording'.

task_completion.description: The recording runs for at least 10 seconds.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The recording timer in the GUI shows a duration of at least 00:00:10 before the recording is stopped.

task_completion.description: The agent stops the recording and the session.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Stop Recording' button is clicked, and the data stream is halted.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the OpenBCI GUI rather than using terminal commands to simulate files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movements and button highlights within the OpenBCI GUI interface.

integrity.description: The recording duration progressed naturally in the GUI timer.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the recording timer incrementing (e.g., from 2s to 10s) rather than jumping instantly.

integrity.description: The EEG traces show active synthetic waveforms during the recording.
integrity.visual_evidence: The time-series graph displays moving waveforms consistent with synthetic EEG data generation.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The default recording directory is /home/ga/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Recordings. A valid 10-second recording at the standard 250 Hz sample rate must contain approximately 2500 rows of data and result in a file size of roughly 167 KB. The VLM should verify the 'Synthetic' source is selected and the GUI timer reaches at least 10 seconds.
